Finding and hypothesis: One endpoint match may not transfer
Measurements and comparison: At multiple inlet and flow states, record inlet/outlet content and alveolar boundary; freeze reference calibration
Prespecified discrimination: Withheld-state content error and state-related residuals; endpoints test transfer, not direct axial trajectories

Finding and hypothesis: Global gas signals permit different allocation
Measurements and comparison: Regional perfusion plus justified capacity/area mapping; compare fixed, proportional and constrained shares
Prespecified discrimination: Reduction in feasible allocations and improvement of withheld oxygen prediction at target reserve

Finding and hypothesis: Feedback amplification depends on demand limits
Measurements and comparison: Same-state inlet/outlet content and actual use or demand; compare measured inlet with assigned closure
Prespecified discrimination: Simultaneous content and oxygen-use agreement; report unmet demand under the closure

Finding and hypothesis: Volume and membrane capacity identify two combinations
Measurements and comparison: Add independent local hydraulic conductance or validated area observation
Prespecified discrimination: Increased structural rank and adequate practical precision; derived variables alone add no independent row
